title: Minimum color contrast 4.5:1
description: Normal text must have at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against its background (WCAG AA). Large text (18px+ bold or 24px+ regular) requires 3:1.
checks: Measure contrast ratio for all text/background pairs
Use tools like WebAIM contrast checker

title: Visible focus states on interactive elements
description: All interactive elements must have visible focus indicators (2-4px outline or ring) for keyboard navigation.
checks: Focus ring must contrast with background

title: Alt text on meaningful images
description: All meaningful images must have descriptive alt text. Decorative images should have empty alt text (alt="").
checks: Review all img tags for alt attributes
Ensure alt text describes image content

title: ARIA labels on icon-only buttons
description: Buttons with only icons must have aria-label or accessible label that describes the action.
checks: Verify aria-label is present and descriptive
antiPatterns: Hiding the label visually without screen reader support

title: Keyboard navigation order
description: Tab order must match visual reading order. All interactive elements must be reachable by keyboard.
antiPatterns: Tab order different from visual order

title: Form labels with for attribute
description: Every form input must have a visible label element with a for attribute matching the input's id.

title: Skip to main content link
description: A skip-to-content link should be the first focusable element on the page for keyboard users.
checks: It is the first tabbable element
antiPatterns: Skip link not visible on focus
Skip link goes to wrong target

title: Sequential heading hierarchy
description: Headings must follow a logical hierarchy (h1→h2→h3) without skipping levels.

title: Don't convey info by color alone
description: Information must not be communicated through color alone. Add icons, text, or patterns as alternatives.

title: Support system text scaling
description: Text must be able to scale up to 200% without content loss or horizontal scrolling.
checks: Verify no text is cut off
antiPatterns: Content that breaks at larger text

title: Respect prefers-reduced-motion
description: Animations must respect the user's prefers-reduced-motion setting. Provide static alternatives for all motion.
checks: Verify all content is accessible without motion

title: Screen reader support for custom components
description: Custom interactive components (modals, accordions, tabs) must have appropriate ARIA roles, states, and properties.
antiPatterns: Using div as button without role

title: Escape routes in modals and multi-step flows
description: Modals and multi-step flows must provide clear cancel/back/close mechanisms.

title: Preserve system keyboard shortcuts
description: Don't override system and assistive technology keyboard shortcuts. Provide alternatives for drag-and-drop.

title: Minimum touch target 44x44pt
description: Touch targets must be at least 44x44pt (Apple HIG) or 48x48dp (Material Design). Extend hit area beyond visual bounds if needed.
checks: Check padding adds to hit area

title: Minimum 8px spacing between touch targets
description: Touch targets must have at least 8px/8dp gap between them to prevent mis-taps.

title: Don't rely on hover for primary interactions
description: Primary interactions must work with tap/click. Hover-only interactions fail on touch devices.
antiPatterns: Dropdowns that only work on hover

title: Disable buttons during async operations
description: Buttons that trigger async operations must be disabled during loading and show a spinner or progress indicator.

title: Clear error messages near input
description: Validation errors must appear near the relevant input field, not just at the top of the form.
checks: Error is next to the field
antiPatterns: Errors only at top of form

title: Cursor pointer on clickable elements
description: All clickable elements must show cursor:pointer to indicate they are interactive.

title: Avoid horizontal swipe on main content
description: Don't use horizontal swipe on main content areas where it interferes with vertical scrolling. Prefer vertical scroll.
checks: Ensure it doesn't block vertical scroll

title: Use touch-action: manipulation
description: Add touch-action: manipulation to interactive elements to eliminate the 300ms tap delay on mobile browsers.

title: Press feedback on touch
description: Interactive elements must provide visual feedback on press (ripple, highlight, or scale animation).
checks: Press an element and watch for feedback

title: Safe area awareness for notched devices
description: Primary touch targets must stay away from notch, Dynamic Island, gesture bar, and screen edges.
checks: Keep interactive elements in safe zone

title: Provide gesture alternatives
description: Don't rely on gesture-only interactions. Always provide visible controls for critical actions.
checks: Every gesture has a button alternative

title: Use WebP/AVIF image formats
description: Use modern image formats (WebP, AVIF) with fallbacks for better compression and quality.

title: Declare image dimensions to prevent CLS
description: Set explicit width and height on images or use aspect-ratio CSS to prevent layout shift (CLS < 0.1).

title: Use font-display: swap
description: Use font-display: swap or optional in @font-face to prevent invisible text during font loading (FOIT).
checks: Verify text is visible during load

title: Lazy load below-the-fold content
description: Use loading="lazy" for images and dynamic imports for components that are below the initial viewport.

title: Virtualize long lists
description: Lists with 50+ items should use virtualization (react-window, tanstack-virtual) to reduce DOM nodes.

title: Keep main thread under 16ms per frame
description: Per-frame JavaScript work should be under ~16ms for smooth 60fps rendering. Move heavy tasks off the main thread.
checks: Profile with Chrome DevTools Performance tab
Move heavy computation to Web Workers

title: Skeleton screens for >1s operations
description: Operations taking more than 1 second should show skeleton screens or shimmer placeholders instead of spinners.

title: Input latency under 100ms
description: Input response must be under 100ms for taps and scrolls. Delayed responses make the UI feel sluggish.
checks: Measure time from tap to visual feedback

title: Debounce high-frequency events
description: Use debounce or throttle on scroll, resize, and input events to prevent excessive handler execution.
antiPatterns: Expensive calculations on every scroll pixel

title: Match style to product type
description: Choose the visual style that best matches the product type and industry. Use the design system generator for recommendations.

title: Consistent style across all pages
description: The same visual style must be applied consistently across all pages of the application.
checks: Verify all pages use the same style

title: Use SVG icons, not emojis
description: Use SVG icon libraries (Heroicons, Lucide, Phosphor) instead of emoji as icons.

title: Choose palette from product type
description: Color palette should be chosen based on the product type and industry. Use the getPalette tool for recommendations.
checks: Apply palette as CSS custom properties

title: Effects must match chosen style
description: Shadows, blur, border-radius, and other effects must be consistent with the chosen design style.

title: Respect platform conventions
description: Use platform-appropriate navigation patterns, controls, and interactions. iOS HIG differs from Material Design.
checks: Respect safe areas and system behaviors

title: Make interactive states visually distinct
description: Hover, pressed, disabled, and active states must be visually distinct while staying consistent with the style.

title: Consistent elevation scale
description: Use a consistent shadow/elevation system for cards, sheets, and modals. Avoid random shadow values.

title: viewport meta tag
description: HTML pages must have viewport meta tag with width=device-width, initial-scale=1. Never disable user zoom.
checks: maximum-scale is not set too low

title: Mobile-first responsive design
description: Design for mobile screens first, then progressively enhance for tablet and desktop.

title: Systematic breakpoints
description: Use consistent breakpoints across the application. Standard: 375px (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1024px (desktop), 1440px (wide).

title: Minimum 16px body font on mobile
description: Body text must be at least 16px on mobile to prevent iOS auto-zoom on input focus.
checks: Body font-size is at least 16px on mobile
Test by tapping an input on iOS

title: Line length control: 35-75 characters
description: Optimal line length is 35-60 chars on mobile and 60-75 chars on desktop for comfortable reading.

title: No horizontal scroll on mobile
description: Content must not cause horizontal scrolling on mobile devices. Everything must fit the viewport width.
checks: Use overflow-x: hidden on body if needed
antiPatterns: Tables without horizontal scroll on mobile

title: Use spacing scale system
description: Use a 4px/8dp incremental spacing scale (0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64) for consistent spacing.

title: Comfortable touch density
description: Component spacing should be comfortable for touch interaction — not cramped, not causing mis-taps.

title: Consistent max-width on desktop
description: Use a consistent max-width (typically max-w-6xl or max-w-7xl) on desktop layouts to prevent overly wide content.
checks: Set max-width on main content containers

title: z-index management system
description: Define a layered z-index scale (0, 10, 20, 40, 100, 1000) for consistent stacking.

title: Fixed element offset for safe areas
description: Fixed navbars and bottom bars must reserve safe area padding for notched devices and system bars.

title: Line height 1.5-1.75 for body text
description: Body text line height should be between 1.5 and 1.75 for optimal readability across devices.

title: Consistent type scale
description: Use a defined type scale (e.g., 12, 14, 16, 18, 24, 30, 36, 48) instead of arbitrary font sizes.
checks: Apply scale to all text elements

title: Semantic color tokens
description: Use semantic color tokens (primary, secondary, surface, text-primary, etc.) instead of raw hex values in components.
antiPatterns: Raw hex color values in components

title: Animation duration 150-300ms
description: Micro-interactions should animate between 150-300ms. Complex transitions ≤400ms. Avoid >500ms.
checks: Shorter for subtle effects, longer for emphasis

title: Use transform/opacity for animations
description: Animate only transform and opacity properties. Never animate width, height, top, left, which trigger layout recalculations.

title: Show skeletons for loading >300ms
description: If loading takes more than 300ms, show skeleton screens or progress indicators instead of blank space.

title: Animate 1-2 key elements per view
description: Limit animations to 1-2 key elements per view to avoid overwhelming users.

title: Use ease-out for entering, ease-in for exiting
description: Elements entering use ease-out (fast start, slow end). Elements exiting use ease-in (slow start, fast end).

title: Motion must have meaning
description: Every animation must express a cause-effect relationship. Motion without purpose is visual noise.
checks: Ask: what does this animation communicate?
Ensure animation supports the user's task
antiPatterns: Animation just because it looks cool

title: Smooth state transitions
description: State changes (hover, active, expanded, collapsed) should animate smoothly, not snap instantly between states.

title: Visible labels on form fields
description: Every form field must have a visible, persistent label. Placeholder text is not a substitute for labels.
checks: Labels stay visible when field is filled
antiPatterns: Floating labels that hide on autofill

title: Inline validation errors
description: Validation errors must appear next to the relevant field, not just at the top of the form.
checks: Error messages are next to the field
Each field has its own error message
antiPatterns: All errors listed at the top only

title: Helper text for complex inputs
description: Complex form fields should have helper text that explains the expected format or provides examples.
checks: Add helper text below the field
antiPatterns: Helper text that is too verbose

title: Progressive disclosure in forms
description: Show only relevant form fields. Use conditional reveals, multi-step forms, or collapsible sections for complex forms.

title: Predictable back navigation
description: The back button should navigate to the previous logical screen, not necessarily the browser history.
checks: Modal close vs back distinction is clear
antiPatterns: Broken back navigation after form submission

title: Bottom navigation limited to 5 items
description: Mobile bottom navigation should have no more than 5 items. More items should use overflow or tab patterns.

title: Deep linking support
description: Every screen should be reachable via a direct URL (deep link) for sharing and bookmarking.
checks: Verify every screen has a unique URL
Test deep links from external sources

title: Legend and labels on charts
description: Every chart must have a visible legend and axis labels for proper data understanding.

title: Accessible chart colors
description: Chart color schemes must be accessible to color-blind users. Use patterns or labels in addition to color.

title: Summary metrics first on dashboards
description: Dashboards should display summary KPIs prominently at the top before detailed charts and data.
checks: KPI cards are above the fold
Most important metric is most prominent
antiPatterns: Too many metrics competing for attention

title: Appropriate chart type selection
description: Choose the chart type that best represents the data relationship: bar for comparison, line for trends, pie for composition.
checks: Use donut instead of pie for multiple series
antiPatterns: Pie charts with too many slices

title: Interactive chart tooltips
description: Data points on charts should show tooltips with exact values on hover or tap.

title: Filter controls visible and responsive
description: Dashboard filter controls must be easily accessible and respond within 500ms of user interaction.

title: Empty and error states for all data views
description: Every data view must handle empty states (no data), error states (failed load), and loading states.
checks: Loading state shows skeleton or spinner

title: Consistent icon style within project
description: Use one icon set consistently across the entire project. Don't mix Heroicons, Lucide, Font Awesome, and Material Icons.

title: Blur only for background dismissal
description: Use backdrop blur to indicate elements below are inactive (modals, sheets). Don't use blur purely as decoration.
checks: Blur is used on active overlays

title: Single primary CTA per screen
description: Each screen should have one clearly primary call to action. Secondary actions should be visually subordinate.
antiPatterns: Primary CTA is hard to find

title: Dark mode uses desaturated colors
description: Dark mode colors should be desaturated lighter tonal variants, not inverted colors. Test contrast separately.
checks: Avoid pure white on pure black

title: Weight hierarchy reinforces structure
description: Use font-weight to reinforce hierarchy: bold headings (600-700), regular body (400), medium labels (500).

title: Prefer wrapping over truncation
description: Text should wrap naturally rather than truncating. When truncating, use ellipsis and provide full text via tooltip.
checks: Ensure containers allow text to wrap
Use text-overflow: ellipsis only when needed
antiPatterns: Hidden content without way to reveal

title: Tabular figures for data columns
description: Use tabular/monospaced figures for data columns, prices, and timers to prevent layout shift as values change.
antiPatterns: Layout shift as dashboard values update

title: Spring physics for natural feel
description: Prefer spring/physics-based animation curves instead of linear or cubic-bezier for more natural-feeling motion.

title: Test at 375px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px
description: Always test UI at standard breakpoints: 375px (mobile), 768px (tablet), 1024px (desktop), 1440px (wide).
checks: Check for layout breaks at each
Test interactive elements at mobile sizes

title: Parallax must respect reduced-motion
description: Parallax effects must have a static fallback when prefers-reduced-motion is set.
antiPatterns: Essential content revealed only through parallax

title: Fixed navbar offset for content
description: Fixed navbars must reserve appropriate padding-top on main content to prevent overlap.
checks: Main content has padding-top equal to navbar height
Check for content hidden behind navbar

title: Prefer min-h-dvh over 100vh on mobile
description: Use min-height: 100dvh (dynamic viewport height) instead of 100vh to account for mobile browser chrome.
checks: Test on mobile with address bar visible/hidden
Use CSS fallback for older browsers
antiPatterns: 100vh sections that are taller than the viewport on mobile

title: Error feedback within 100ms of tap
description: Visual feedback for touch interactions must appear within 100ms to feel responsive.
antiPatterns: Feedback only appears after action completes

title: Avoid pixel-perfect taps
description: Don't require pixel-perfect precision for interactive elements. Ensure adequate size and generous hit areas.
checks: Test with thumb on large phone

title: Swipe actions must show affordance
description: Swipe-to-action interactions must show clear affordance: chevron, partial content peek, or visual hint.
checks: Add visual hint for swipe actions
antiPatterns: Hidden swipe actions with no indicator

title: Loading states for all async operations
description: Every async operation must have a visible loading state. Skeleton for content, spinner or progress for actions.

title: Success confirmation after form submission
description: Form submissions must show a success confirmation (toast, banner, or inline message) after successful submission.

title: Consistent form field width
description: Form fields should have consistent widths within the same form. Don't mix full-width and narrow fields arbitrarily.

title: Visual hierarchy through size, spacing, contrast
description: Create visual hierarchy primarily through size, spacing, and contrast — not through color alone.
checks: Important elements are larger or more contrasted
Related elements are grouped with spacing

title: Staggered entrance animations
description: Multiple elements entering together should stagger their animation timing (50-100ms delay per item).
checks: Don't stagger so long it feels slow

title: Reduce reflows in animations
description: Avoid frequent layout reads/writes during animation. Batch DOM reads then writes to prevent forced reflows.

title: Font pairing match brand personality
description: Typography pairing should match the brand personality. Formal brands use serif, modern brands use sans-serif, creative brands use display fonts.
